rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice, especially before organizations, activities, or projects involving charity.

example.english: This philanthropic organization helps many poor people every year.
example.traditional: 呢個慈善機構每年都會幫助好多窮人。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 bong1 zo6 hou2 do1 kung4 jan4

rows.note: Use this casual expression when describing a person who is kind-hearted and willing to help others, rather than a charitable organization.

example.english: They are very philanthropic and always help when they see someone in trouble.
example.traditional: 佢好有善心，見到人有困難就會幫手。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 jau5 sin6 sam1 gin3 dou2 jan4 jau5 kwan3 naan4 zau6 wui5 bong1 sau2

rows.note: Use this idiom for someone notably generous and charitable, especially in formal or written descriptions.

example.english: Mr. Lee is philanthropic and often donates to support public welfare.
example.traditional: 李先生樂善好施，經常捐款支持公益。
example.jyutping: lei5 sin1 saang1 lok6 sin6 hou3 si1 ging1 soeng4 gyun1 fun2 zi1 ci4 gung1 jik1
